# Beyond Convex: Nonlinear Programming (Demo) {#sec-dnlp}

<!-- DEMO (instructor-run), CRAN-reproducible at home via Uno + sparsediff;
     ipopt dropped. Source: cvxr_docs/examples/dnlp/tutorial.qmd, trimmed. -->

::: callout-note
## What you'll be able to do
Recognize when a problem is smooth-but-nonconvex, and see how CVXR hands it to a
nonlinear solver (`Uno`) using automatic differentiation (`sparsediff`).
:::

::: callout-important
## Demo chapter (Phase 3)
Run by the instructor; reproduce it at home with
`install.packages(c("Uno","sparsediff"))` (no `ipopt` needed).
See [DNLP Tutorial](https://cvxr.rbind.io/examples/dnlp/tutorial.html).
:::
